capabilities: Collect wild Pokemon by throwing a Pokeball during rarity-weighted encounters
Evolve collected Pokemon through repeat encounters
Configure the pet's size, active Pokemon, wiki link, and visibility from a pet menu
Run Pomodoro timer presets with Pokemon completion notifications
Look up Pokemon data from PokeAPI with an offline bundled fallback roster
extras: Unofficial fan-made plugin, not affiliated with Nintendo, Game Freak, The Pokemon Company, PokeAPI, or Pokemon Showdown. States that remote lookups send only Pokemon IDs and sprite URLs, never vault content. Installable via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian has no playful companion or gamification element to make working in the vault more engaging.

relations.evidence: When remote data is enabled, it fetches structured Pokemon data from the public PokeAPI
uses transparent pixel sprites from Pokemon Showdown

summary: Adds a collectible pixel Pokemon pet that wanders along the bottom of the workspace, with wild encounters, catching, evolution, and a Pomodoro timer.
